question: Who among the following Indian music composers won the Oscar award in the year 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MM Keeravani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MM Keeravani **is a renowned Indian music composer who has composed music for many **Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, and Hindi films**.

 
 
• He won the** Oscar award in 2023**. He was awarded for the song **"Naatu Naatu"** from the movie** "RRR"** in the category of **Best Original Song**.
 
• He won the National Film Award for Best Music Direction for the** Telugu film Annamayya in 1997 and the Filmfare Award for Best Music Director in Telugu film for the film Magadheera in 2009.**
 
• MM Keeravani is also known for his work in the **Baahubali film series,** for which he received* critical acclaim and international recognition.*
 
 
 
• **Mani Sharma** has composed music for many Telugu and Tamil films. 
 
• **AR Rahman** is a well-known composer who has won many international awards, including Oscars.
 
• **Devi Sri Prasad** is a popular music composer who has worked in Telugu and Tamil films.
 
• However, none of them won the Oscar award in the year 2023, as mentioned in the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Academy Award**

 
• The Oscar is also known as the Academy Awards.
 
• It is a set of awards given for artistic and technical merit in the American film industry.
 
• The award is given annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Science.
 
• **AR Rahman is an Indian composer, singer, and songwriter who has won the 81st Academy Award. Hence option 2 is correct.**
 
• The 2020 Oscars award this year was the 92nd in its series.
 
• This year's Oscar was very special as it honored a non-English film "Parasite" with the Best Picture Award.
